repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziG2t1d9cfRQJDrHkB

Close-out: 2026-11-24T05:21Z · area ux-C · p0 · landed by PR #36844 (merge `47ed85d2c0c7b77dda6f0bb6e67058a57179a96d`, head `e96a55605f05c693b1dc077550c5cd660894bd6f`; L1 ACCEPT 7122452658, addendum 7122464017). Cause reproduced before code: 「+ 新建」 was the last row inside the list's scroll container, so the available-height clamp cut it first; inside a dialog the portalled popover sat outside the scroll lock, so the list could not be scrolled to it. Now quick-create and 「查看全部结果」 sit in a footer pinned under the list (same `canCreate` gate), and the lookup popover is modal so its list scrolls inside a dialog (seat route: modal for every lookup accepted). Nits stay in the review record: N2 PeoplePicker inline has the same lock (requested from triage as a card), N3 no e2e geometry pin. The phone face continues in #36832. `pm:dispatched` removed.
